delivery: Source changes are integrated in the primary repository; not confined to a separate preview. No public/ build, branch switch, worktree creation, commit or push.
changes: Every public Home/content reload replays the white whale, even after a prior visit.
Content reveal waits for the load event rather than DOM parsing alone; recovery remains bounded.
Home has a 30-second startup preparation budget instead of the previous 12 seconds.
The legacy bare-title/text-only static story is replaced visually by a complete illustrated entrance and existing project links.
Reduced motion keeps a stationary white-background whale. History restoration retains its existing behavior.
The current /next content and existing concurrent changes are preserved. Its static entrance receives the same replacement; its entry loader remains isolated.
The parser-time white shield now shares the loader’s body stacking context. Team page fixed-body and blur effects no longer cover, scale or blur the whale.
shared_template_patch: Only one home_static_entry.html include was added to each live Home template. Existing /next edits belong to other tasks and were not overwritten.
checks_passed: tests/entry_loading.mjs: session/reload policy, readiness, 12-second regression, reduced motion, failure recovery, cleanup and whale renderer.
tests/entry_loading_worker.mjs: independent rendering, resize/pointer messages and termination.
tests/entry_scene_budget.mjs: first-frame readiness and covered scene rendering budget.
tests/opening_warmup.mjs: resource preparation, origin guards and cleanup.
Live 8181 HTTP response includes the new fallback component.
Browser: slow module cover remains active after 14 seconds; failed modules hide the legacy story on desktop and phone; no-JavaScript and reduced-motion entries remain illustrated.
Browser inner-page retry passed: an already-visited /team reload shows the whale and waits for a deliberately held eager image before revealing the destination (results.json).

broader_checks.targeted_recheck: The transitive module scanner passed after concurrent shared-test edits. The /attributions markdown-content assertion still fails, unrelated to entry loading.

browser_limits: Full animated WebGL playback could not be confirmed in this local headless environment: GPU-enabled attempts timed out. The normal headless run used the illustrated fallback. Browser screenshots verify the white whale and fallback layout; they do not prove all animated chapters.
concurrency: The existing shared-integration lock was respected. Our two-template patch was applied under our own atomic lock and that lock was released. Other Home tasks continued modifying the same checkout, so these checks describe the observed state, not a guarantee against future concurrent writes.
